name: pnpm
notes: PNPM_STORE_PATH is a command placeholder, not a pnpm configuration variable: always pass the store-dir flag on install. Preserve project install-script approval settings. Keep the store and checkout on the same filesystem when practical; cross-device copies are acceptable. Do not run pnpm setup, global installs or Corepack enable. The store is concurrent; node_modules stays checkout-local.
